title: Honey Glazed Japanese Speck Bake
description: A Japanese dish inspired by Okinawan flavors featuring speck, a type of cured pork, in a sweet honey glaze, perfect for a solo dinner. The dish is wood-fired baked, making it a unique and delicious meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) or a wood-fired oven to 500°F (260°C).
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil for easy cleanup.
Arrange the speck slices on the prepared baking sheet in a single layer, leaving a little space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together the honey, sesame oil, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sugar-free sweetener until smooth.
Brush the honey glaze evenly over the speck slices, making sure each piece is coated.
Sprinkle the green onions over the top of the speck.
Bake the speck in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until caramelized and slightly crispy.
During the last 2 minutes of baking, add the miso paste to the honey glaze and brush it over the speck again.
Remove the speck from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the honey glazed speck hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
